description: Retrieve a single EU trademark by its application or registration number from the EUIPO — "look up EUTM 018123456". Returns the full record (mark text, status, owner/representative, Nice classes, goods & services, filing/registration/expiry dates) plus raw. Example: euipo_trademark({ number: "018123456" })

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own EUIPO client_id:client_secret; Pipeworx supplies one if omitted.

number.description: EUTM application or registration number, e.g. "018123456".

name: euipo_trademark
title: Euipo Trademark
